conversation_starters.title: San Francisco sees surge in all-cash home sales driven by AI boom
conversation_starters.summary: San Francisco, the major city about 45 miles northwest of San Jose, CA, is seeing a surge in all-cash home sales driven by the AI boom.
questions: Have you noticed the AI boom affecting the housing market where you are?
Is buying a home in the Bay Area on your radar at all these days?

you_should_know.title: Overnight Hwy. 101 closures begin between South San Francisco and East Palo Alto
you_should_know.summary: Overnight closures begin on Hwy. 101, the main freeway running up the Peninsula northwest of San Jose, CA, between South San Francisco and East Palo Alto (both suburbs 20 to 35 miles northwest of the city).
